checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact port widths and names; combinational continuous assignments; logical OR produces one bit; inverted b occupies bits 5:3 and inverted a bits 2:0. No clock, reset, state, or pipeline required.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed all development checks and was retained without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before development checks.
limitations: Development simulation covers binary inputs; X/Z inputs were not tested.
No synthesis, timing analysis, or board validation performed.
